entries.title: Dispatch quote request does not finish
entries.root_cause: The oversized quote handler holds the non-reentrant rate-table mutex while refreshOversizeRates waits to acquire the same mutex, leaving the request pending. Remove the nested acquisition.

entries.title: Dispatch page button selector is stale
entries.root_cause: The dispatch test selects the former Send dispatch button name, but the page now exposes the button as Submit dispatch. Update the dispatch page selector.

entries.title: Ledger page button selector is stale
entries.root_cause: The ledger test selects the former Export ledger button name, but the page now exposes the button as Download ledger. Update the ledger page selector.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e2, a button locator times out, but this is a different page and selector requiring a separate correction.

entries.title: Dispatch quote request still does not finish
entries.root_cause: The oversized quote handler holds the non-reentrant rate-table mutex while refreshOversizeRates waits to acquire the same mutex, leaving the request pending. Remove the nested acquisition.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run uses another worker, a changed test line and a longer test timeout; the same oversized parcel quote request remains pending.
